Administrative data

Additional information

What the visitor folder must contain
  • Visitor sign-in log
  • Class roster (ATRRS R2 report, SSNs removed)
  • Current training schedule
  • Course POI or course management plan, and the current lesson plan
  • Instructor credentials: certification certificate or Commandant's MFR, operator's permit if needed, instructor biography
  • A copy of TF 600-21-1
  • Feedback or observation forms for visitors

The course runs one DD Form 2977 common to all lessons. For the risk assessment check, confirm it is signed by the approval authority and that the block 13 review is current, not just that a copy exists.

6

Final scores

SectionPointsPercentage

Thresholds printed on this version of the form: 80% for Basic Army Instructor, 85% for Senior, 90% for Master. A single Unacceptable in any item overrides the total and produces a no-go. TR 600-21 (2 May 2018) still cites 12, 16, and 20 points; those figures belong to the earlier four-item rubric the May 2023 revision replaced.

Instructors

Academic instructor hours

Mirrors USAACE (DOTD) Form 2657-R. Only primary-instructor hours count: hours the lesson plan allocates to a single lead instructor responsible for the learning objective (TR 600-21 para 3-4b). Basic needs 80 after certification; Senior and Master each need 200 more, counted from the day after the previous packet was submitted (para 3-4c). Time is entered in hours and minutes, the way the lesson plan carries it, and written to the 2657-R as h:mm. Date every entry; undated hours cannot be placed in a window.
